newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's property firm sees profit double in '96.
newsitem.headline: China's property firm sees profit double in '96.

text.p: Shenzhen Nanyou Property Development Stock Co Ltd will report net earnings for 1996 doubled from the previous year's 19.43 million yuan, a company spokesman said on Friday.
A turnaround in Shenzhen's real estate market in the second half of 1996 lifted sales of Nanyou's properties, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The company's profits in 1996 mainly came from sales of a 125-million-yuan residential complex of 300,000 square metres, which started in June 1994 and ended last year, the official said.
Detailed results would not be released until an audit has been completed, he said.
The firm had net earnings of 13.05 million yuan in the first half of 1996 compared with 9.42 million yuan in the same period of 1995.
